checkpoint_outcome: Stop semantic expansion; preserve partial inventory. Receipt writing continues only.

t.definition: At a written entry t, create the one opaque Workpiece identified by this native entry source ID, initialize explicit case scope at sampling ordinal 0, and form a POINT question about INTEGRITY. Requires an empty scope; t elsewhere cannot reset a live case.

o.definition: Read owner from the explicit case scope. No nearest-noun or guessed-owner default.

k.definition: Retain the supplied owner, set property INTEGRITY and mode POINT, baseline null. The fixed property is an unconfirmed C0 choice.

q.input: PredicateTemplate + earlier matching ObservationReport + current CaseScope
q.definition: Preserve owner and property; require an earlier report for that owner/property at a strictly earlier sampling ordinal. Set mode HISTORY_CONTRAST and retain its report ID and value as baseline. Missing or ambiguous baseline blocks. Do not copy its answer as the new answer.

aN.definition: Copy owner/property/mode/baseline from its actual predicate input and bind the explicit current sampling ordinal. Output fields must be read by the later consumer.

d.input: last completed ObservationReport in explicit current case
d.definition: Recover the earlier question owner, property, mode and baseline; drop its sampling time and answer. A later aN must supply current sampling time. Requires an actual completed report; no universal left host, right host or next-CHEDY assumption.

l.input: last completed ObservationReport in explicit current case
l.definition: Recover the same earlier question owner/property/mode/baseline, drop answer and sampling time. This is an explicitly charged semantic alias of d, not confirmed l/d identity.

p.definition: Advance the sampling ordinal by one and stamp the supplied predicate, preserving its owner/property/mode/baseline. An OwnerRef alone is insufficient. This is sampling advance, not a universal THEN.

Cedy.definition: Read owner, property, sampling ordinal, mode and baseline from the actual question. Require fresh evidence indexed by exactly that owner/property/time. POINT returns the current Boolean value. HISTORY_CONTRAST additionally computes current value != baseline value using the supplied matched report. This instruction changes state only when executed; no observations are supplied or executed here.

qok.route: q(ok(CaseScope), matched earlier ObservationReport, current CaseScope)

okaN.capacity: Second-only form disclosed in advance; no occurrence evaluated.

qokaN.route: aN(qok(CaseScope, matched earlier report), current CaseScope)

lpchedy.route: Cedy(p(l(last completed report), current CaseScope), fresh evidence)

op.status: TYPE_GAP: p requires PredicateTemplate, o returns OwnerRef

policies.opaque_naming: Exactly one name may be instantiated by a written entry t at an EmptyCaseScope: Workpiece(entry source ID). No unknown word, repeated residual or line boundary introduces a name.
policies.entry: The initial IT paragraph-start t is the sole attempted entry. No implicit line resets. Its three paid commitments are disclosed above; they are choices, not evidence.
policies.reference: Explicit current case and last completed report only. No invisible co-reference, occurrence-index routing or unknown-noun filler. Missing state blocks.
policies.evidence: The only hypothetical prefix evidence is symbolic v0 and v1, each indexed by its respective owner/property/time. It is not supplied manuscript evidence, historical effectiveness, or an executed observation.
policies.residuals: Listed exact pair residuals license only the written routing above. No residual introduces owner/property/measurement/effect, repairs an incompatible type, or creates a whole episode. Unlisted residuals are unassigned.
policies.shared_component_scope: d/l/p/q/o/k/aN functions retain their definitions at every proposed application. Unreached occurrences are not executed. Cedy is a licensed whole final unit; no translation of its C/e/d/y internals is claimed.
policies.boundaries: Native separators and paragraph flags stay as recorded. No semantic sentence boundary inferred from each row. Alternate uncertain seams remain uninterpreted.
policies.time: Sampling ordinals are an explicit paid model convention. There is no independent temporal anchor or observed clock value.
policies.no_repair: No adapter from OwnerRef to PredicateTemplate, no additional default property, no free question closure, no episode alias, no historical-baseline invention.

first_gap.first_obligation: Attempted op=[o,p]: o returns OwnerRef; p requires PredicateTemplate containing owner and property. No written k or frozen adapter supplies the missing template.
first_gap.decision: Partial candidate. Do not derive later rows from guessed continuation.
